name: Milena’s mother’s letter
description: A letter left by Milena’s mother. Press Enter to read.
readingText:
My dear Milena,
I have not been feeling well since I started working at the factory. I hear voices even when I am alone in this room. Shadows move where nobody is standing, and I see people who vanish when I turn on the light. I cannot tell what is real anymore. I have put this letter in the safe in room 21. If I cannot explain what happened, please remember that I love you.
Mother
